title: Encoded dynamic program length bound
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, bit string $x$, and natural numbers $s,V,t$, the word produced by the dynamic-programming encoding has length at most $V\bigl(2(2Vt+1)+2\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
